inline_comments.comment:
The `-o, --output` option is defined on `aiCommand` (the parent `ai` command) instead of the `prepare` subcommand. In Commander.js, options defined on a parent command must appear *before* the subcommand name in the CLI invocation. This means the actual working syntax would be `storybook ai -o path.md prepare`, but the PR description documents `npx storybook ai prepare -o path/to/prompt.md` — that form will fail with `error: unknown option '-o'` because the `prepare` subcommand doesn't define that option.

The fix is to move the `.option('-o, --output <path>', ...)` call to the `prepare` subcommand block (alongside the existing `--config-dir` option), and revert the action handler back to its simpler original form since the parent-option-merging workaround would no longer be needed for `--output`.

The `cmd.parent?.opts()` merging was introduced here as a workaround to access `--output` from the parent command's option bag. If `--output` is moved to the `prepare` subcommand (fixing the placement bug above), this workaround becomes unnecessary and the action handler can be simplified back to the original `async (options) => { ... }` form. As-is, the workaround also silently changes how `logfile` is resolved for this command (picking it up from parent opts rather than from `options` directly), which may or may not reflect a pre-existing bug in the original code.

general_comments.comment: No automated tests are added for the new `--output` functionality (the PR checklist has all test categories unchecked). At minimum, a unit test for `aiPrepare` that asserts the file is written when `output` is provided — and that `logger.log` is called with the confirmation message rather than the markdown content — would prevent regressions and document the expected behavior.
